description: Claim requests and answers, without a network: what the SDK refuses to send, the exact body it sends, and how every gateway answer becomes an outcome. `patch` is applied over `baseRequest` (or `bodyPatch` over `claimedBody`); {"$delete": true} removes a field.

toClaimBody.name: sends the total in taka, not poisha
keeps poisha as a fraction of a taka
normalises the transaction ID the way the server does
names the wallet only when asked to
sends the payer's phone when there is one
trims the key and the order ref, and drops a blank ref
accepts a shortfall only when asked to, and says so last
anything but true is not an acceptance

interpret.name: a new claim is CLAIMED, taka back to poisha
a 200 is a replay of our own earlier claim
float taka rounds to the nearest poisha
a missing overpaidBy is zero
an offset claimedAt is read as UTC
a 'claimed' answer below the total is refused, as a second look
logs: Payment gateway claimed 8F3K2M9X01 for 100000 poisha against 125000 expected

interpret.name: an accepted shortfall is CLAIMED, with what is still owed
the shortfall is our own sum, not the body's
accepting a shortfall changes nothing when the payment is in full
